camel_example: aliyun ecs DescribeAutoSnapshotPolicyEx --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key TestKey --PageSize 10 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-aek2kkmhmhs0000' --PageNumber 1 --Tag.1.Value TestValue --AutoSnapshotPolicyId 'sp-bp67acfmxazb4ph0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AutoSnapshotPolicyName TestName
description_en: Queries the details of automatic snapshot policies that are created in a specified region
description_zh: 本接口用于查询指定地域下已创建的自动快照策略详细信息列表
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-auto-snapshot-policy-ex --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --auto-snapshot-policy-id sp-bp67acfmxazb4ph0000 --auto-snapshot-policy-name TestName --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --resource-group-id rg-aek2kkmhmhs0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAutoSnapshotPolicyEx

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the automatic snapshot policies that you want to query. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的自动快照策略所在的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the automatic snapshot policy
parameters.name: auto_snapshot_policy_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the automatic snapshot policy. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain characters that are classified as letter in Unicode, including Chinese characters, English letters, and digits. The name can also contain colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), or hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 自动快照策略的名称。长度为2~128个字符，支持Unicode中letter分类下的字符（其中包括英文、中文和数字等）。可以包含半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: auto_snapshot_policy_name

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the automatic snapshot policy list. The results are displayed on multiple pages.

Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
自动快照策略返回结果分多页展示。

起始值：1。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page when the automatic snapshot policies are displayed by page.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页展示返回的自动快照策略时的每页行数。

最大值：100。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

fields.help_en: The tag key of the automatic snapshot policy. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. The tag key cannot contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 自动快照策略的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value of the automatic snapshot policy. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 自动快照策略的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能包含http://或者https://
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group. If you use this parameter to filter resources, the resource count cannot exceed 1,000.

Filtering by the default resource group is not supported
parameters.help_zh:
资源组ID。使用该参数过滤资源时，资源数量不能超过1000个。

不支持默认资源组过滤
parameters.name: resource_group_id

AutoSnapshotPolicy.description_en: The collection of automatic snapshot policy details
AutoSnapshotPolicy.description_zh: 自动快照策略详情集合

items.description_en: The details of an automatic snapshot policy

AssociationType.description_en:
The association type between the automatic snapshot policy and target resources. Valid values:
● AssociatedWithDisk: associated with disks.
● AssociatedWithInstanceTag: associated with instance tags
AssociationType.description_zh:
自动快照策略与目标资源的关联类型。可能值：
● AssociatedWithDisk：关联云盘
● AssociatedWithInstanceTag：关联实例标签
AssociationType.title_zh:
自动快照策略与目标资源的关联类型。可能值：
● AssociatedWithDisk：关联云盘
● AssociatedWithInstanceTag：关联实例标签

AutoSnapshotPolicyId.description_en: The ID of the automatic snapshot policy

AutoSnapshotPolicyName.description_en: The name of the automatic snapshot policy

CopiedSnapshotsRetentionDays.description_en: This parameter is in invitational preview and is not publicly available
CopiedSnapshotsRetentionDays.description_zh: 该参数正在邀测中，暂未开放使用

CopyEncryptionConfiguration.description_en: The encryption parameters for cross-region snapshot replication
CopyEncryptionConfiguration.description_zh: 快照跨地域复制加密参数对象

Encrypted.description_en:
Indicates whether encrypted cross-region snapshot replication is enabled. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled.

Default value: false
Encrypted.description_zh:
是否开启快照跨地域加密复制。取值范围：

true：是。
false：否。

默认值：false

KMSKeyId.description_en: The ID of the KMS key used for encrypted cross-region snapshot replication
KMSKeyId.description_zh: 快照跨地域加密复制使用的KMS密钥ID

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the automatic snapshot policy was created. The time follows the [ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html） standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreationTime.description_zh: 创建时间。按照[ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html）标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

DiskNums.description_en: The number of disks that use this policy
DiskNums.description_zh: 启用该策略的云盘数量
DiskNums.title_zh:
启用该策略的云盘数量。
说明  该参数仅包含关联类型为 AssociatedWithDisk 的云盘数量。

EnableCrossRegionCopy.description_en: This parameter is in invitational preview and is not publicly available
EnableCrossRegionCopy.description_zh: 该参数正在邀测中，暂未开放使用

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the automatic snapshot policy
RegionId.description_zh: 自动快照策略所属的地域ID

RepeatWeekdays.description_en: The days of the week on which automatic snapshots are created. Valid values: 1 to 7, where 1 indicates Monday. Multiple days can be specified
RepeatWeekdays.description_zh: 指定自动快照的重复日期。选定周一到周日中需要创建快照的日期，参数为1~7的数字，如1表示周一。允许选择多个日期

RetentionDays.description_en:
The retention period of the automatic snapshot. Unit: days. Valid values:

-1: The snapshot is permanently retained.
1 to 65536: The snapshot is retained for the specified number of days
RetentionDays.description_zh:
指定自动快照的保留时间，单位为天。可能值：

-1：永久保存。
1~65536：指定保存天数

Status.description_en:
The status of the automatic snapshot policy. Valid values:

Normal: The policy is normal.
Expire: The policy cannot be used because the account has an overdue payment
Status.description_zh:
自动快照策略状态。可能值：

Normal：正常。
Expire：由于账号欠费无法使用该策略

Tag.description_en: The tag key-value pairs of the automatic snapshot policy
Tag.description_zh: 自动快照策略的标签键值集合

items.description_en: The tag key-value pairs of the automatic snapshot policy
items.description_zh: 自动快照策略的标签键值集合

TagKey.description_en: The tag key of the automatic snapshot policy
TagKey.description_zh: 自动快照策略的标签键

TagValue.description_en: The tag value of the automatic snapshot policy
TagValue.description_zh: 自动快照策略的标签值

TargetCopyRegions.description_en: This parameter is in invitational preview and is not publicly available
TargetCopyRegions.description_zh: 该参数正在邀测中，暂未开放使用

TargetTag.description_en: The list of target resource tags. The automatic snapshot policy matches target resources based on tags
TargetTag.description_zh: 目标资源标签列表。自动快照策略根据标签匹配目标资源
TargetTag.title_zh: 目标资源标签列表。自动快照策略根据标签匹配目标资源。

TimePoints.description_en:
The points in time at which automatic snapshots are created.

The time is displayed in UTC+8. Unit: hours. Valid values: 0 to 23, where 0 indicates 00:00 and 1 indicates 01:00. Multiple points in time can be specified.

The parameter value is a JSON array in the format of `["0", "1", ... "23"]`. A maximum of 24 points in time can be specified, separated by commas (,)
TimePoints.description_zh:
指定自动快照的创建时间点。

使用UTC +8时间，单位为小时。从00:00~23:00共24个时间点可选，参数为0~23的数字，如：1代表在01:00时间点。可以选定多个时间点。

传递参数为JSON数组格式：`["0", "1", ... "23"]`，最多24个时间点，用半角逗号字符（,）隔开

Type.description_en:
The type of the automatic snapshot policy.

Custom: a user-defined snapshot policy.
System: a system-defined snapshot policy
Type.description_zh:
自动快照策略类型。

Custom：用户定义的快照策略。
System：系统定义的快照策略

VolumeNums.description_en: The number of extended volumes that use this policy
VolumeNums.description_zh: 启用该策略的拓展卷数量

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the automatic snapshot policy list
PageNumber.description_zh: 自动快照策略列表的页码

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page when the automatic snapshot policies are displayed by page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页展示返回的自动快照策略时的每页行数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of automatic snapshot policies
TotalCount.description_zh: 自动快照策略的总个数
